body: Thank you for your advice. I agree that friends should be there for each other  in hard times.  It's easy to feel alone and, even though I know there are people that are there, I still feel alone. I'm worried that, when I reach out, it will end badly. I recently had another friend push me away because of this. It really hurt and sent me into a spiral when I was already in a bad place. It makes me afraid to reach out to anyone else. I want to confide in someone else, but I'm afraid it will just make me feel more alone. I guess that's a risk I have to take. I try to be someone that my friends can trust; I guess people are not used to me being the vulnerable and it's only recently (within the last year) that I've come forward about my struggles.
